title: Turnal consenting installation analytics
scope_label: Directional pseudonymous data from consenting installations

source.count_rule: Command volume always sums the numeric count property; aggregate event rows are never command executions.
source.ordering_rule: Same-day milestones are an unordered set. No query establishes order within a UTC date.

weekly_recording_active.description: Distinct consenting installations with a completed recorded turn in the inclusive seven-date UTC window.
weekly_recording_active.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS recording_active_installations FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()

activated_installations.description: Date-level init plus validated adapter or wrapped-run milestone; same-day rows are unordered.
activated_installations.query: WITH milestones AS (SELECT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS event_date, maxIf(1, properties.metric = 'workspace.initialized') AS initialized, maxIf(1, properties.metric IN ('adapter.configured.claude', 'adapter.configured.codex', 'command.run.success')) AS configured FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' GROUP BY distinct_id, event_date), init AS (SELECT distinct_id, minIf(event_date, initialized = 1) AS init_date FROM milestones GROUP BY distinct_id) SELECT count(DISTINCT milestones.distinct_id) AS activated_installations FROM milestones INNER JOIN init ON milestones.distinct_id = init.distinct_id WHERE milestones.configured = 1 AND milestones.event_date >= init.init_date

d7_recording_retention.description: Activated installation with a recording metric exactly seven UTC dates after activation.
d7_recording_retention.query: WITH activation AS ({activated_installation_dates}), recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS record_date FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex')) SELECT count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT activation.distinct_id), 0) AS d7_recording_retention FROM activation LEFT JOIN recording ON activation.distinct_id = recording.distinct_id AND recording.record_date = activation.activation_date + 7 WHERE activation.activation_date <= today() - 7

d30_recording_retention.description: Activated installation with a recording metric exactly thirty UTC dates after activation.
d30_recording_retention.query: WITH activation AS ({activated_installation_dates}), recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS record_date FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex')) SELECT count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT activation.distinct_id), 0) AS d30_recording_retention FROM activation LEFT JOIN recording ON activation.distinct_id = recording.distinct_id AND recording.record_date = activation.activation_date + 30 WHERE activation.activation_date <= today() - 30

feature_adoption.description: Distinct installations using each successful public feature among weekly recording-active installations.
feature_adoption.query: WITH weekly_recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()) SELECT properties.metric AS feature, count(DISTINCT events.distinct_id) AS feature_active_installations, count(DISTINCT weekly_recording.distinct_id) AS recording_active_installations FROM events INNER JOIN weekly_recording ON events.distinct_id = weekly_recording.distinct_id WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND properties.metric IN ('command.log.success','command.sessions.success','command.show.success','command.search.success','command.diff.success','command.blame.success','command.rollback.success','command.replay.checkout.success','command.replay.move.success','command.replay.remove.success','command.run.success') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today() GROUP BY feature HAVING recording_active_installations >= 20

command_success_rate.description: Count-weighted reliability by canonical command family.
command_success_rate.query: SELECT replaceRegexpOne(properties.metric, '\.(success|failure)$', '') AS command_family, sumIf(toUInt64(properties.count), properties.metric LIKE '%.success') AS successes, sumIf(toUInt64(properties.count), properties.metric LIKE '%.failure') AS failures, successes / nullIf(successes + failures, 0) AS success_rate FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND properties.metric LIKE 'command.%' GROUP BY command_family

adapter_mix.description: Installation adoption and aggregate completed-turn count by adapter.
adapter_mix.query: SELECT properties.metric AS adapter, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS installations, sum(toUInt64(properties.count)) AS completed_turns FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex') GROUP BY adapter HAVING installations >= 20

active_version_share.description: Weekly active installation mix by released version.
active_version_share.query: SELECT properties.turnal_version AS turnal_version, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_installations FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_daily_active' AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today() GROUP BY turnal_version HAVING active_installations >= 20 ORDER BY active_installations DESC

operational_sources.schema_rejection_rate: collector HTTP counters grouped only by released client version
operational_sources.outbox_delivery_health: collector state counts, oldest pending age, and synthetic canary reconciliation
operational_sources.accepted_volume_anomaly: collector accepted daily batch count with a five-times baseline alert
